snippet.title: Pactsworn - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Pactsworn on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5096860/PactSworn/

PactSworn is a bullet heaven survival game where you play as a warlock to cut through endless hordes of eldritch monsters. Fight through various randomly generated maps - each with their own different challenges - in order to find and purge the source of the corruption! Level up and equip weapons, traits, and augments to design potent builds and see how far you can make it!

Collect various weapons, each with different kinds of attacks, to assemble your build to mow through hordes of enemies! Each weapon has associated traits, which grant additional effects to your character to provide even more power! Mix and match different weapons and traits to build powerful synergies and unleash chaos!

#indiegame #gaming #vampiresurvivors #roguelike #gamedev
